answer: The sonnet I would price into every new account is Proof of unique beach cleanup participation: cleanups joined yearly at the same beach for five years, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since cleanups joined yearly at the same beach for five years takes calendar time as well as money — and the quartz is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The reef is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
